note: 550 5.4.1 Recipient address rejected: Access denied on 2026-11-11; use the public contact form
subject: One panel BED + redacted report for a research-use readiness check?
body: Hi — I maintain Contig, a local research-use workflow that checks coverage readiness and builds an HTML report with hashed provenance. I am validating it on real panel/WES data and looking for one panel BED or gene list with the transcript policy you use, and (separately) 1–2 fully redacted reports you already produce. Nothing patient-identifying leaves your lab; I can sign a redaction/data-use agreement first. In return I will send a short summary of how the readiness states and report provenance compare to your expectations. Would that be possible? — East Genomics enquiry.
